question: Which of the following awards in the field of dance, art and music is given by the Government of Madhya Pradesh ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalidas Samman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Kalidas Samman is a prestigious award given by the Government of Madhya Pradesh in the fields of classical music, classical dance, theatre, and plastic arts.
 
• It was instituted in 1980 and is named after the classical Sanskrit writer Kalidasa.
 
• The award is presented annually and includes a cash prize, a plaque, and a citation.
 
• The Kalidas Samman recognizes and honors the exceptional contribution of artists in their respective fields and promotes the cultural heritage of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sanatan Sangeet Sanskriti Samman**

 
 
• It is an award that honors the contribution of artists in the field of Indian classical music and dance.
 
• It is not specifically associated with the Government of Madhya Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**
 
 
• It is the highest recognition given to practicing artists by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India’s National Academy of Music, Dance & Drama.
 
• These awards are given by the Government of India and not specifically by the Government of Madhya Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Tagore Ratna**
 
 
• It is an award instituted by the Indian government to honor the contributions of artists in the fields of music, dance, and theater.
 
• The award is named after Rabindranath Tagore and is not specifically associated with the Government of Madhya Pradesh.
